title: Abbas Sughra Se Kaho
body:
Na jao.. na jao
Haaye..
Qafla jab ke rawana tha sue karbobala
aake abbas se kehne lagi rokar sughra
chacha jaan aapki baat mere baba nahi talenge
aap baba ko manalenge chacha jaan
le chaliye mujhe karbobala saath
chacha jaan, le chaliye mujhe karbobala saath
Maula abbas ne jakar ye shahe dee'n se kaha
bibi zidd karti hai le chaliye use karbobala..(2)
Hussain ya hussain...
Hussain bole..
Aye mere bhai alamdaar
<<MINI>>
Abbas sughra se kaho, tum ghar mein raho
abbas, abbbas, abbas..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Hum jaha'n jaenge mahaul sharabi hoga
sar chupane ke liye hogi mayassar na rida
<<MINI>>
sabr karna shahzadi
<<DIVIDER>>
ek sabab hai aur magar
<<MINI>>
tum shabih e fatima ho
mai kaise tumhe le jau karbala
